description: Implementation of BufferNULL class methods for null renderer in ANGLE project, handling buffer data operations such as setData, setSubData, copySubData, mapping, and index range retrieval.

classes.name: BufferNULL
classes.description: A null renderer implementation of buffer object handling in ANGLE, providing buffer data management without actual GPU resource allocation.

methods.name: BufferNULL
methods.description: Constructor initializing BufferNULL with buffer state and allocation tracker.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets buffer data, resizing internal storage and updating memory allocation.

methods.name: setSubData
methods.description: Updates a subset of buffer data at a specified offset.

methods.name: copySubData
methods.description: Copies data from another buffer object into this buffer.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps entire buffer data for access.

methods.name: mapRange
methods.description: Maps a range of buffer data for access.

methods.name: unmap
methods.description: Unmaps the buffer, indicating data is ready.

methods.name: getIndexRange
methods.description: Computes index range for drawing operations based on buffer data.
